name: Robert Branche
original_name: ロベール・ブランシェ
source:
A pharmacist in the royal palace.
He is also familiar with medicine.
There are many people who yearn for him who is mild and good at listening, and he is always a good consultant for everyone.

[Taken from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/100puri/chara/100robert_branche.html]official website[/url]]
